Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Attach additional data disk to your lab VM

Body.Content:
In Azure DevTest Labs, you can now attach additional data disks to your lab virtual machines, including new and existing data disks in the lab. To do that, select the VM where you want to attach additional data disks, and then select the Disks (OS, attached) settings:

Attach a new data disk by specifying the disk name, storage type (standard or premium), and size:

Use Attach existing to pick a data disk that you've already created in the lab:

To detach a data disk from the VM, select that data disk and click the Detach button:

Please try it today and let us know what you think about it! If you have an idea for how to make it work better for you, submit your feedback (or vote for others) at the Azure DevTest Labs feedback forum.

Have a question? Check out answers or ask a new question at the MSDN Community forum.
